description: This file contains API utility functions for a frontend dashboard, including functions to resolve API base URLs, fetch data from various endpoints, and retrieve module overviews and metrics. It handles HTTP requests, processes responses, and exports key functions for other parts of the frontend application.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines a reliable API base URL by trying environment variables, heuristics based on current window location, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL with optional credentials, appends organization ID as query parameter if applicable, parses JSON or text response, and throws error on failure.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes different data shapes (array, object with data/items) into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a dashboard overview from multiple endpoints, falling back to collecting deployment, user, and cost summaries if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total metrics for users and deployed applications for dashboard overview.
